notes: Seven screens from the walk; the navigation drawer and the delete confirmation are not counted. Each item and each inventory has one home, the edit screen, with no repeats (the view and search results are read-only; opening an unknown code on home creates an inventory, which is creation, not a repeat). One step per tap, and tapping a field and typing is one step. R09 opens the box from the inventory list (2 taps); a scan is 1 step but needs the box in hand, which the before-buying scenario does not give. R11 treats a box as the group and the place, as the app's model does, and moves by removing and retyping, the only way the app allows (the walk notes give about 8 taps per move); the retyped names are recall because the other box is not shown. R05 is null (no tags), R06-R08 null (no photos or recognition), R10 null (one level of boxes, no map), R114 and R115 null (no prices).
